title: Feature: Added support for clickable states using the click directive
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR adds support for the `click` directive in `stateDiagram` syntax, allowing nodes to become clickable and open external URLs in a new tab. Tooltips are also supported.

Resolves https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/issues/6314
Resolves https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/issues/6304

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

- Introduced `click` directive parsing in `stateDiagram.jison`, supporting both:
```
click StateA "https://example.com" "Tooltip"
click StateB href "https://docs.com"
```

- The links are stored in a `Map<string, { url, tooltip }>` inside `StateDb`
- Added logic to inject SVG `<a>` tags after rendering using text content matching (to support Mermaid v3 renderer, which does not assign `ids` to state nodes)
- Tooltip and link behaviors work as expected using standard SVG interactivity

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/87a2e473-6ec9-46bd-a433-a0b9658ed882
